sources.snippet: Canada's province of Alberta rejected a plan to hold a binding independence referendum, results showed Tuesday, a win for unity as the country faces worsening ties with the United States. With more than 1.5 million votes counted, 76% supported remaining in Canada, while close to 24% backed beginning a process toward separation, according to unofficial results from Elections Alberta.
sources.title: Alberta rejects move toward independence from Canada

sources.snippet:
Result is a victory for prime minister Mark Carney and supporters of Canadian unity

Voters in Canada’s Alberta have overwhelmingly rejected a proposal to begin a process towards independence, delivering a victory for the prime minister, Mark Carney, and supporters of Canadian unity.

With more than 1.5m votes counted, 76% supported remaining in Canada, while close to 24% backed beginning a process toward separation, according to unofficial results from Elections Alberta.

SPD und Grüne stimmen für Koalitionsgespräche Zwei Tage nach dem Abschluss der Sondierungen in Berlin haben sich SPD und Grüne für die Aufnahme von Koalitionsverhandlungen bereit erklärt. Die Linke will Ende Oktober auf einem Parteitag darüber entscheiden.
